facts.text: Nal Hutta, also known simply as Hutta, was a hot, swampy planet located deep within Hutt Space of the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Hutt species and headquarters of the Grand Hutt Council.

evidence.quote: Nal Hutta, also known simply as Hutta, was a hot, swampy planet located deep within Hutt Space of the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Hutt species and headquarters of the Grand Hutt Council.

facts.text: Nal Hutta was a major haven for both the government—aligned Hutt Clan and other criminal elements of the galaxy, located far from galactic authorities.

evidence.quote: Nal Hutta was a major haven for both the government—aligned Hutt Clan and other criminal elements of the galaxy, located far from galactic authorities.

facts.text: Its terrain was largely bloated swamps and bogs coated in greasy rains, all of which were greatly exacerbated by the Drengir crisis during the High Republic Era.

evidence.quote: Its terrain was largely bloated swamps and bogs coated in greasy rains, all of which were greatly exacerbated by the Drengir crisis during the High Republic Era.

facts.text: Nal Hutta, known also as just Hutta was a ringed planet nestled in the depths of Hutt Space and was located in the Outer Rim Territories and The Slice. It was a mist-covered swamp world with a hot, humid and fetid climate maintained by thick swampy rain that fell almost perpetually.

evidence.quote: Nal Hutta, known also as just Hutta was a ringed planet nestled in the depths of Hutt Space and was located in the Outer Rim Territories and The Slice. It was a mist-covered swamp world with a hot, humid and fetid climate maintained by thick swampy rain that fell almost perpetually.

facts.text: The world was a hotbed of life and its environment was fairly representative of the sentient Hutt species that inhabited the world.

evidence.quote: The world was a hotbed of life and its environment was fairly representative of the sentient Hutt species that inhabited the world.

facts.text: The planet's surface was covered with numerous bogs with what little solid land there was claimed by the Hutts and used to support their homes.

evidence.quote: The planet's surface was covered with numerous bogs with what little solid land there was claimed by the Hutts and used to support their homes.

facts.text: The Hutts built only a handful of spaceports on the surface of Nal Hutta in order to connect their towns, settlements, and palaces, as the planet received few visitors due to most business with offworlders being conducted on the planet's largest moon, Nar Shaddaa.

evidence.quote: The Hutts built only a handful of spaceports on the surface of Nal Hutta in order to connect their towns, settlements, and palaces, as the planet received few visitors due to most business with offworlders being conducted on the planet's largest moon, Nar Shaddaa.

facts.text: The foremost of these spaceports was the planet's capital city, Bilbousa, a sprawling mess covered in arching roots that spread out from looming bulbous pods.

evidence.quote: The foremost of these spaceports was the planet's capital city, Bilbousa, a sprawling mess covered in arching roots that spread out from looming bulbous pods.

facts.text: Within sight of the city was the Palace of Gardulla Besadii the Elder, one of the largest buildings on Nal Hutta, which served as the occasional headquarters of the Grand Hutt Council, the ruling body that both worked and led the Hutt Clan.

evidence.quote: Within sight of the city was the Palace of Gardulla Besadii the Elder, one of the largest buildings on Nal Hutta, which served as the occasional headquarters of the Grand Hutt Council, the ruling body that both worked and led the Hutt Clan.

facts.text: Under the Hutt's control, the planet shared a reputation with Nar Shaddaa for being polluted and dangerous, but played a leading role in the galaxy's shadow economy.

evidence.quote: Under the Hutt's control, the planet shared a reputation with Nar Shaddaa for being polluted and dangerous, but played a leading role in the galaxy's shadow economy.

facts.text: The Hutt Clan was based off Nal Hutta.

evidence.quote: The Hutt Clan was based off Nal Hutta.

facts.text: Once, Nal Hutta was a planet full of teeming cities.

evidence.quote: Once, Nal Hutta was a planet full of teeming cities.

evidence.quote: After freeing Ziro the Hutt from prison on Coruscant, the bounty hunter Cad Bane brought the fugitive Hutt to the Grand Hutt Council on Nal Hutta.

facts.text: Ziro refused to divulge the location of his secret holodiary and was imprisoned by the Hutt Council.

evidence.quote: Ziro refused to divulge the location of his secret holodiary and was imprisoned by the Hutt Council.

facts.text: While on an undercover mission to save Supreme Chancellor Palpatine from Separatist assassins, Kenobi, who was disguised as the bounty hunter Rako Hardeen, and the fugitives Bane and Moralo Eval crash-landed on the swamps of Nal Hutta.

evidence.quote: While on an undercover mission to save Supreme Chancellor Palpatine from Separatist assassins, Kenobi, who was disguised as the bounty hunter Rako Hardeen, and the fugitives Bane and Moralo Eval crash-landed on the swamps of Nal Hutta.

facts.text: Nal Hutta (Glorious Jewel in Huttese), also known simply as Hutta, was the capital of Hutt Space and was located in the Y'Toub system.

evidence.quote: Nal Hutta (Glorious Jewel in Huttese), also known simply as Hutta, was the capital of Hutt Space and was located in the Y'Toub system.

facts.text: The planet was controlled by the ancient ruling Hutt families, who also ruled its moon Nar Shaddaa from Nal Hutta and became the new capital of Hutt Space.

evidence.quote: The planet was controlled by the ancient ruling Hutt families, who also ruled its moon Nar Shaddaa from Nal Hutta and became the new capital of Hutt Space.

facts.text: Nal Hutta, or as it was originally known, Evocar, was a very large planet deep within Hutt Space and formed part of the Mid Rim and the Slice, however it lacked natural heavy metals meaning its density was less than that of most worlds.

evidence.quote: Nal Hutta, or as it was originally known, Evocar, was a very large planet deep within Hutt Space and formed part of the Mid Rim and the Slice, however it lacked natural heavy metals meaning its density was less than that of most worlds.

facts.text: The planet was originally a lush jungle world with vast oceans, though the Hutts eventually transformed it into a polluted and barren wasteland.

evidence.quote: The planet was originally a lush jungle world with vast oceans, though the Hutts eventually transformed it into a polluted and barren wasteland.

facts.text: Once it became known as Nal Hutta, much of the surface became covered by flat, marshy bogs, stagnant, muddy puddles and patches of sickly marsh grass inhabited by insects and spiders.

evidence.quote: Once it became known as Nal Hutta, much of the surface became covered by flat, marshy bogs, stagnant, muddy puddles and patches of sickly marsh grass inhabited by insects and spiders.

facts.text: The few other species to survive the Hutt's environmental changes mutated and adapted to the pollutant laden environment.

evidence.quote: The few other species to survive the Hutt's environmental changes mutated and adapted to the pollutant laden environment.

facts.text: The areas still habitable by the native species were viciously competed for making the many of the species on Nal Hutta some of the most aggressive animals in the galaxy.

evidence.quote: The areas still habitable by the native species were viciously competed for making the many of the species on Nal Hutta some of the most aggressive animals in the galaxy.

facts.text: The atmosphere was also polluted by strip-mining operations and heavy industrialization, and a greasy rain drizzled down on the surface, although its terrain was not to the extent of Dagobah.

evidence.quote: The atmosphere was also polluted by strip-mining operations and heavy industrialization, and a greasy rain drizzled down on the surface, although its terrain was not to the extent of Dagobah.

facts.text: Raw materials were constantly strip-mined from the planet's surface and shipped to Nar Shaddaa for processing and export.

evidence.quote: Raw materials were constantly strip-mined from the planet's surface and shipped to Nar Shaddaa for processing and export.

facts.text: The capital city, Bilbousa and the Guarja Shipyards were located on the planet.

evidence.quote: The capital city, Bilbousa and the Guarja Shipyards were located on the planet.

facts.text: The Huttese translation of Nal Hutta into Glorious Jewel stemmed from the nearby massive, radioactive gas cloud, which contained the planet Ganath.

evidence.quote: The Huttese translation of Nal Hutta into Glorious Jewel stemmed from the nearby massive, radioactive gas cloud, which contained the planet Ganath.

facts.text: The planet was ruled by the oldest Hutt families, known as the Clans of the Ancients, who watched over the activities of both Nal Hutta and Nar Shaddaa from their homes.

evidence.quote: The planet was ruled by the oldest Hutt families, known as the Clans of the Ancients, who watched over the activities of both Nal Hutta and Nar Shaddaa from their homes.

facts.text: Prior to 15,000 BBY, the Hutt settlers owned a small province on Evocar.

evidence.quote: Prior to 15,000 BBY, the Hutt settlers owned a small province on Evocar.

facts.text: Due likely to their legendary greed, the Hutt's ownership of Evocar continued to grow through business deals where they traded their technology with the relatively primitive Evocii for portions of land.

evidence.quote: Due likely to their legendary greed, the Hutt's ownership of Evocar continued to grow through business deals where they traded their technology with the relatively primitive Evocii for portions of land.

facts.text: Following the destruction of the Hutt home-world of Varl in 15,000 BBY, the Hutts collaborated with Vippit lawyers from Alee in buying out the planet from the Evocii, regarding it as a suitable new home.

evidence.quote: Following the destruction of the Hutt home-world of Varl in 15,000 BBY, the Hutts collaborated with Vippit lawyers from Alee in buying out the planet from the Evocii, regarding it as a suitable new home.

facts.text: Using both legal and violent measures, the Hutts established themselves as the rulers of the planet and renamed it Nal Hutta, as the new capital of Hutt Space, the successor of the Hutt Empire.

evidence.quote: Using both legal and violent measures, the Hutts established themselves as the rulers of the planet and renamed it Nal Hutta, as the new capital of Hutt Space, the successor of the Hutt Empire.

facts.text: Hutt palaces, amusement parks and other constructions were built all over Evocar, and the Evocii could do nothing about it.

evidence.quote: Hutt palaces, amusement parks and other constructions were built all over Evocar, and the Evocii could do nothing about it.

facts.text: The Evocii appealed to the Galactic Republic, however the contracts signed were legally binding, and the Republic ruled in favor of the Hutts.

evidence.quote: The Evocii appealed to the Galactic Republic, however the contracts signed were legally binding, and the Republic ruled in favor of the Hutts.

facts.text: Many of the Evocii were eventually evicted by the Hutts, and relocated to the planet's fifth moon, which would later be known as Nar Shaddaa, the Smugglers' Moon.

evidence.quote: Many of the Evocii were eventually evicted by the Hutts, and relocated to the planet's fifth moon, which would later be known as Nar Shaddaa, the Smugglers' Moon.

facts.text: The Hutts then destroyed the remaining Evocii agriculture and whatever was left of the original terrain and then terraformed (destroyed) any remaining patches of land.

evidence.quote: The Hutts then destroyed the remaining Evocii agriculture and whatever was left of the original terrain and then terraformed (destroyed) any remaining patches of land.

facts.text: Most of the Evocii who remained on Nal Hutta were enslaved to build the cities of Nal Hutta.

evidence.quote: Most of the Evocii who remained on Nal Hutta were enslaved to build the cities of Nal Hutta.

facts.text: The few remaining Evocii not enslaved in the cities banded together into rebel tribes to harass the Hutts and their interests, ultimately they were defeated and exterminated.

evidence.quote: The few remaining Evocii not enslaved in the cities banded together into rebel tribes to harass the Hutts and their interests, ultimately they were defeated and exterminated.

evidence.quote: The resettled Evocii were exploited as indentured labor to build the cities of the moon.

evidence.quote: Five centuries later, the entire moon was urbanized and the Evocii were freed of their labor by the Hutts.
